newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Ingosstrakh 95 premiums double to 600 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Ingosstrakh 95 premiums double to 600 bln rbls.

text.p: Premiums written 600 bln rbls 279 bln rbls
Net provisions for claims 181 bln 12 bln

NOTE - Full name Strakhovoye Aktsionernoye Obshchestvo Ingosstrakh. Figures are consolidated, unaudited and converted to international accounting standards from Russian standards by Arthur Andersen. Arthur Andersen audited only Ingosstrakh's Moscow parent company. Premiums written, claims paid and provision for claims are net of reinsurance.
Figures do not quantify the effects of inflation.

Ingossktrakh is Russia's second biggest insurer. Shareholders include Russian Federal Property Fund, Aviabank, AKB Tokobank, AKB Avtobank, OAO GAZ and AMO ZiL carmakers, International Moscow Bank and Itar-Tass news agency. Ingosstrakh also owns stakes in Avtobank and Tokobank
Ingosstrakh owns 91 percent of London-based Black Sea and Baltic General Insurance Co Ltd.
Dollar on Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX):
Year-on-year consumer price inflation rate in December 1995 was 131 percent after 215 percent in December 1994 and 840 percent in December 1993.
